column3: The head becomes a spring instead of water; “slain daughter” replaces the slain of the daughter of the people.
The contrast of strength and faithfulness is recast as lies prevailing over truth; “take Me into account” stands for knowing Me.
Tongues and arrows are plural instead of singular.
The final two actions are put in reverse order.
“Hearts” is plural instead of a collective singular.
“Most” supplies a superlative for the skilled women.
The two reasons are linked as one reason for leaving.
“Yet uncircumcised” interprets the expression of circumcision in foreskin.
